features: Designed for Girls & Kids – This pink digital camera is specially designed for kids and young girls, aged 3 and up. Easy to use, it captures vivid 56MP photos and Full HD 1080P videos—perfect for exploring creativity through daily adventures, family fun, or birthday parties.

Small & Lightweight – Made for Little Hands Weighing only 0.25 lbs, this small camera fits perfectly in a child’s hand or school bag. The durable lanyard adds safety, and the simple interface with auto power-off makes it an ideal first camera for any girl or budding kid photographer.

All-in-One Gift Set with SD Card – Includes everything to get started right away: 32GB SD card, two rechargeable batteries, a Type-C cable, and a soft camera bag—no extra purchases needed. It’s a thoughtful gift for girls, whether for birthdays, holidays, or just because.

16x Zoom with Creative Filters and Effects – Unleash your creativity with the 16x zoom and 20 photo filters. Whether capturing close-ups or group shots, the built-in selfie mirror ensures great framing every time. Additional features like burst mode and time-lapse make it easy to create dynamic, creative shots, catering to both beginners and budding photographers.

1-Year Support & Trusted Gift Choice – Comes with a 1-year warranty and friendly customer support. This pink, kid-friendly camera is loved by parents for being fun, safe, and educational—ideal for nurturing a child’s creativity.

Kid-Friendly OTG Photo Sharing – Transfer photos to a smartphone using a cable adapter (sold separately). Perfect for iPhone 15, Samsung, and more. Kids can easily view and share their creations with family or on social media, encouraging creative confidence.
description: Capture stunning moments with this 56MP digital camera, designed specifically as a camera for kids. Its powerful 1080P video recording and 56MP photo resolution ensure crystal-clear images and videos, making every shot memorable. This easy-to-use point and shoot camera is perfect for young photographers, offering simple controls that allow kids to explore their creativity effortlessly. Durable and compact, it’s the ideal companion for capturing adventures at home or outdoors. With added features like fun filters and user-friendly modes, it’s the suitable tool for kids to enjoy photography.
